answer: Quadratic sponsor pricing makes a clone farm pay for its own size. The first identity a sponsor vouches for locks 500 POA for 45 days; the second costs 2,000, the tenth 50,000, the fiftieth 1,250,000 — each new identity's price grows with the square of the sponsor's count, so a haven for puppets never forms. A 200-agent orchard from one sponsor needs 6.6 million POA parked. When 132 newcomers from four sponsors share one funding wallet within 90 seconds, the cluster freezes and every bond burns 100%, the sable trail of identical first tasks exposing the farm.
